summary: Frontend E2E for Trade Hub merge. Admin: /admin/trade loads with all 4 tabs; Dashboard renders 8 KPIs, range chips, 4 lists (never-logged-in / dormant / expiring / top), bulk buttons, dormant expiry controls; Traders tab shows login-status chips, channel/activity filters (no Pricing Tier), badges, single send-login-link works with expected 'not sent' toast (example.com rejected by Resend), bulk button label updates; Trader 360 drawer on Smoke Trade Ltd shows all stat cards + action buttons + tabs, timeline filters, credit-expiry controls incl. super-admin expire-now, ledger table renders. Manual credit adjust dialog: add £7.25 (balance £12.50 → £19.75), remove £7.25 (back to £12.50), overflow attempt shows client-side toast "Balance can't go below £0 (currently £12.50)". Notes tab saves 'QA Rep' + 'qa note' with 'Saved' toast. Credit tab shows ledger table, search + range chips. Settings tab renders. All 4 legacy trade routes (/admin/trade-accounts, /trade-list, /trade-account-settings, /trade-credit-emails) redirect to /admin/trade with correct tab. Website hub (/admin/website-hub) shows Trade Hub card after Sample Orders; Customers hub (/admin/customers-hub) shows Trade Hub card and no 'Legacy'. Storefront: no Bronze/Silver/Gold text on /shop/trade/login, /shop/trade/account, /shop/trade/register or /. Trade account /shop/trade/account no longer shows a tier badge or 'Discount Rate' tier copy; T-00024 and £12.50 credit render correctly. Discount tab shows credit history with 'Adjustment by Tile Station' entries (from admin QA test + earlier tests). CartSaveBanner correctly hidden for logged-in trade (/shop/tile-cart) and reappears for guest after clearing tile_shop_token. Direct product link works: /shop/collection/Dolomite%20Onyx?sku=LP-3631 pre-selects 'Dolomite Onyx Blanco 30x60cm Polished' (different from default 120x120cm Matt).

issues: Legacy 'How Discount Tiers Work' section still references 'tier' language ('Get a discount on every order based on your tier'). No Bronze/Silver/Gold names remain, but the copy should be reviewed since tiers are disabled.
Radix DialogContent a11y warning: missing DialogTitle. Wrap the dialog title text in a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to avoid the console warning.
Pre-existing React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in AdminDashboard render — not blocking.

action_items: (Nit) Rewrite the 'How Discount Tiers Work' explainer on /shop/trade/account Discount tab to remove 'based on your tier' wording, since tiers are disabled.
(Nit) Add DialogTitle inside CreditAdjustDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: TradeHub tabs, redirects, and role-gating (super-admin only Settings tab / expire-now / adjust-credit) render correctly end-to-end.
CreditAdjustDialog client-side validation prevents negative balances with a clean toast — good UX.
CartSaveBanner correctly returns null for isTrade — verified live for both authenticated trade session and guest fallback.
?sku= handling in CollectionDetailPage correctly overrides the default cheapest/first product selection.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Manual credit adjustments (+£7.25 then -£7.25) added and reverted; balance restored to £12.50. Trader notes/rep set to 'QA Rep' / 'qa note' on Smoke Trade Ltd (persist across drawer reopens).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trade Hub feature is stable in preview. Actual hub routes are /admin/website-hub and /admin/customers-hub (not /admin/website /admin/customers as noted in the task prompt). Storefront trade session uses localStorage tile_shop_token / tile_shop_customer. Discount tab of /shop/trade/account still contains a legacy 'How Discount Tiers Work' subsection referencing 'tier' — cosmetic only.
